task.title: To view or edit a segment style

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce).
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab, click the More icon () and select Segment.
Select Segment Regular from the segments list in the Segments pane and click the Settings icon() next to the segment name.

info.p: This opens the Segment Regular page with the segment style set for that segment.

step.cmd: To edit the style, click the Edit icon () next to Style.

To add a segment condition, click Add Condition. This opens the Segment Condition window which has the expression builder. For more information, see To make a Segment Conditional in a template. After adding a condition to the segment, a Lighting icon () is added.

Segment Regular style segment changes to Segment Conditional after you add a condition. When you generate a document using a template with style segments, you can view different styles applied in the generated document.
